titleEn: Find Servers That Handled Most Number of Requests
title: 找到处理最多请求的服务器
summary: k 台服务器按请求编号从 i%k 开始循环选择首个空闲者，忙碌则请求丢弃，返回处理请求最多的服务器。
insight: 有序集合维护空闲服务器，最小堆按结束时间维护忙碌服务器。请求到达前释放完成者，再用 ceiling(i%k) 查首选服务器，不存在则环绕到集合首项。
pitfalls: 完成时间等于到达时间时服务器已空闲
分配顺序从 i%k 环形开始
丢弃请求不影响服务器状态

solutions.title: 空闲有序集与忙碌小根堆
solutions.idea: 分别按编号选服务器、按时间释放服务器。
steps: 请求 i 到达时释放 finish<=arrival[i]；若 available 为空丢弃
server=ceiling(i%k) 或 first，移出 available、count++、加入 busy；返回最大 count 的所有编号

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> busiestServers(int k,int[] arrival,int[] load){TreeSet<Integer> available=new TreeSet<>();for(int server=0;server<k;server++)available.add(server);PriorityQueue<long[]> busy=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(state->state[0]));int[] count=new int[k];for(int i=0;i<arrival.length;i++){while(!busy.isEmpty()&&busy.peek()[0]<=arrival[i])available.add((int)busy.poll()[1]);if(available.isEmpty())continue;Integer server=available.ceiling(i%k);if(server==null)server=available.first();available.remove(server);count[server]++;busy.offer(new long[]{(long)arrival[i]+load[i],server});}int maximum=Arrays.stream(count).max().getAsInt();List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int server=0;server<k;server++)if(count[server]==maximum)answer.add(server);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun busiestServers(k:Int,arrival:IntArray,load:IntArray):List<Int>{val available=java.util.TreeSet<Int>();for(server in 0 until k)available.add(server);val busy=java.util.PriorityQueue<LongArray>(compareBy{it[0]});val count=IntArray(k);for(i in arrival.indices){while(busy.isNotEmpty()&&busy.peek()[0]<=arrival[i])available.add(busy.remove()[1].toInt());if(available.isEmpty())continue;val server=available.ceiling(i%k)?:available.first();available.remove(server);count[server]++;busy.add(longArrayOf(arrival[i].toLong()+load[i],server.toLong()))};val maximum=count.maxOrNull()!!;return count.indices.filter{count[it]==maximum}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> busiestServers(int k,vector<int>& arrival,vector<int>& load){set<int> available;for(int server=0;server<k;++server)available.insert(server);priority_queue<pair<long long,int>,vector<pair<long long,int>>,greater<pair<long long,int>>> busy;vector<int> count(k);for(int i=0;i<(int)arrival.size();++i){while(!busy.empty()&&busy.top().first<=arrival[i]){available.insert(busy.top().second);busy.pop();}if(available.empty())continue;auto it=available.lower_bound(i%k);if(it==available.end())it=available.begin();int server=*it;available.erase(it);++count[server];busy.push({(long long)arrival[i]+load[i],server});}int maximum=*max_element(count.begin(),count.end());vector<int> answer;for(int server=0;server<k;++server)if(count[server]==maximum)answer.push_back(server);return answer;} };
